title: Block Contract v0
description: A harvested repo/subsystem/component normalized into an installable building block for the Actionist Builder. Formalizes SISO/design/BLOCK-FRAMEWORK.md. v0 = draft for the hand-conversion pilot; expect breaking changes until one real block has passed admission.

kind.description: scaffold = app shell a build starts from; feature = vertical slice (routes+schema+UI); component = UI unit (shadcn-registry shaped); theme = token set only; integration = external-service adapter behind an interface; schema-pattern = reusable data model + migrations

provenance.description: Non-negotiable. Harvest-protocol rules apply: MIT/Apache/BSD/ISC harvestable; GPL/AGPL reference-only (must not appear here as a block); unlicensed = summarize-don't-copy.

adaptation_log.description: Every transform applied during extract/standardize, in order. This log from the hand pilot becomes the automation spec.

stack_contract.description: What the block assumes about its host. Composition is only legal between blocks whose stack_contracts unify.

system.description: v0 admits exactly one styling system. All color/space/type values must resolve through var(--*) token slots — hardcoded values fail admission.

data.description: THE standardization bet: one dialect (Postgres), one ORM per registry generation.

tables_owned.description: Tables this block's migrations create. Two blocks owning the same table cannot co-install.

auth_interface.description: Blocks call interface-shaped hooks (auth.getUser()), never a provider SDK directly

interfaces_required.description: Non-auth interface-shaped deps the host must bind (billing, storage, email, ...)

provides.description: What the block exports to the assembled app.

components.description: shadcn-registry-shaped entries: name + files + registry deps

migrations.description: Ordered Postgres migration file paths within the block

events.description: Event names this block emits (for cross-block wiring)

requires.description: Block dependency edges, by id pattern (version range allowed)

tokens_consumed.description: Design-token slots this block reads. The image-gen loop (P2) writes these; the block must render correctly under ANY value assignment.

eval.description: Every block ships its own proof. No unproven blocks in the registry.

smoke_test.description: Command that exercises the block inside the base scaffold; exit 0 = pass

screenshot_baseline.description: Path to baseline image for screenshot-diff gate

admission.description: Filled by the registry at admission time, not by the harvester
